summary: Frontend-only regression at 390x844 for the SVKD COIR rename + Part-Payments/Payment-History + Product-Insights round. ALL 13 requested flows PASS. (1) App loads cleanly, header reads 'SVKD COIR' (also in PDF titles/backup filename). No red screen. (2) Part-payments end-to-end verified: created a PENDING income 5t x 2000 = 10000 (auto-amount 10000.00, badge 'PENDING'); tapping income-status-toggle opens payment-modal with payment-due ₹10,000.00; adding 4000 via payment-amount-input + payment-add-button drops payment-due to ₹6,000.00 and appends one payment-history-row; payment-delete restores due to ₹10,000.00 and removes the row; payment-settle-button drives due to ₹0.00; badge reads 'PAID' (glyph + text), after re-partial 3000 badge reads 'PART PAID', fully-pending reads 'PENDING'. (3) Outstanding pill correctly reflects REMAINING due — with 3000 paid on the 10000 income, pill reads '₹7,000.00 pending · tap to view reminders' (NOT the full 10000). (4) Reminders modal opens from outstanding-pill; all four chips (reminder-days-7/15/30/60) render. Empty state renders correctly for a same-day record (0 days overdue). Aged-record path (reminder-row -> reminder-record-payment / reminder-mark-paid) was previously verified in iteration_5. (5) Product Insights: product-insights card renders in Calendar Month view with scope label 'THIS MONTH', and in Year view with scope '2026'. With Coir Pith ₹10,000 and Coir Bale ₹3,000 in scope it shows both bars and 'Top: Coir Pith'. Card correctly returns null (does not crash) when no income falls in scope. (6) Income tons x cost auto-amount + amount-mode-toggle still work; DatePickerModal opens from filter-date-from as well as record-date-input and payment-date-input. (7) Customers modal (open-customers-button -> customers-modal): DUE badge for TEST PartPay reads '₹7,000.00 DUE' (remaining, not full 10000); customer-statement-button rendered and enabled (not tapped to avoid PDF share on web). (8) Calendar Month/Year toggle, export-month-button (enabled with data), day-detail-modal (opens on calendar-day-row tap), yearly-overview with year-prev/year-next all work. (9) Husk expense unchanged: husk-loads-input + expense-cost-per-trip-input present, NO husk-weight-input. (10) backup-button copies JSON to clipboard on web and shows settings-notice 'Backup copied to clipboard. Paste and save it somewhere safe.' — no crash. restore-button not fully exercised (native picker) per instructions. (11) Data persists across full page reload (income ₹13,000.00 retained). Overall: 13/13 requested flows PASS, previous iteration's badge-toggle regression remains FIXED, and no new regressions. Only carried-over concern is /app/frontend/app/index.tsx has grown further from 1159 to 1295 lines — well past the 700-line threshold.

issues: 'Record a part-payment' section correctly disappears when due hits 0, but the summary block still shows PAID + DUE ₹0.00 with no explicit success affordance; consider a subtle 'Fully settled' banner so the user knows why the input row vanished.

action_items: REFACTOR (P1, tech-debt, carried over): /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is now 1295 lines (up from 1159 last iteration, up from 814 two iterations ago). Split into files under /app/frontend/app/components/: RecordForm, DatePickerModal, PaymentModal, ProductInsights, CalendarView (Month + Year), DayDetailModal, RemindersModal, CustomersModal, Ledger, Filters, ConfirmModal, SettingsPanel — and move buildMonthHTML / buildStatementHTML / escapeHtml into utils/pdf.ts. Non-blocking for release but urgent for maintainability.

Polish (P3): PaymentModal — when due hits 0 after a Settle, the 'RECORD A PART-PAYMENT' section correctly hides but the modal shows nothing to signal the settle was successful; consider adding a small 'Fully settled' inline banner right under the DUE tile.
Polish (P3): PaymentModal payment-date-input defaults to today with no way to switch back to today after opening the DatePickerModal (dp-today exists inside the picker so this is fine, just noting).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx at 1295 lines exceeds the 700-line threshold; split into components/ modules (see action items). Every new feature this round has continued to grow the same monolith.

PaymentModal.commit() (/app/frontend/app/index.tsx:941-944) writes status='paid' as soon as sum(payments) >= amount - 0.009 but does NOT clear payments[] when the record is manually toggled back to pending elsewhere. Because dueOf() prefers paid > 0 branch, a record with paid=amount that is then re-opened via delete-a-payment correctly restores due — however, if a future code path lets the user toggle status directly to 'pending' without touching payments[], dueOf() will still see paid>0 and return amount-paid instead of the full amount. Not exercised by current UI (badge only opens PaymentModal), but worth guarding.

ProductInsights (/app/frontend/app/index.tsx:1011-1033) computes the 'leader' colour by matching p.name === leader; when leader === 'tie' both bars get the fallback (action) colour — visually reasonable, but the 'Top: X' label shows 'Even split' in that case, so consider explicitly styling the tie state (e.g., both bars in a neutral tone) for consistency.

Manual-amount UX asymmetry (carried over from iteration_5): typing in record-amount-input sets manualAmount=true, but editing income-tons-input or income-cost-per-ton-input silently sets manualAmount=false, overriding a user's manual amount. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:460-466.
settings-notice text has no auto-clear timer confirmed (carried over from iteration_5); consecutive backup taps can leave stale success text.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (13 of 13 requested flows PASS; 26 sub-checks executed, 23 auto-pass, 3 counted as fail in the harness are test-script false-negatives explained in the summary — badge text includes an icon glyph so strict-equality failed, and pill/reminders behavior with same-day records is by-design)

seed_data_creation: Test session created 2 incomes in AsyncStorage: TEST PartPay (Coir Pith, 5t x ₹2000 = ₹10,000, part-paid ₹3,000 -> due ₹7,000) and TEST Bale (Coir Bale, 2t x ₹1500 = ₹3,000, paid). Data lives only in browser-local AsyncStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview: https://profit-calculator-111.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport: 390x844. AsyncStorage is per-browser-context; each fresh Playwright run starts empty, so add data in-session before verifying downstream features. Automation tip: page.click(force=True) is unreliable for RN-web Pressables inside sheets — use el.dispatchEvent(pointerdown/pointerup/mousedown/mouseup/click) via page.evaluate. Test-script gotchas discovered: (a) badge/pill text contains a MaterialCommunityIcons private-use glyph (e.g. '\uf740PAID', '\uf740PART PAID', '\uf740PENDING') — never use strict equality on badge text; use `'PAID' in text` and be careful because 'PAID' is also a substring of 'PART PAID' (order your checks accordingly). (b) reminder-row only renders when a pending income's days-since >= overdueDays chip (default 7); same-day test records won't appear — backdate the record date if you need to exercise reminder-row/reminder-record-payment/reminder-mark-paid. (c) outstanding-pill uses remaining due, so partial payments correctly leave it visible with the reduced amount. Nothing broken; all round-6 features (rename, part-payments, product-insights) are green. Only outstanding tech-debt item is the now-1295-line monolithic index.tsx.
